cases.description: Test the nextRecord method with valid tokens to ensure it processes and returns a CSVRecord correctly.

cases.expected: CSVRecord object with last record values
cases.description: Test the nextRecord method when encountering an end of record (EORecord) token to ensure it adds the last record value correctly.
Test the nextRecord method when encountering an EOF token with ready state to ensure it adds a trailer comment correctly.
Test the nextRecord method when encountering an EOF token without ready state to ensure it returns null.

cases.expected: IOException with message indicating invalid parse sequence
cases.description: Test the nextRecord method when encountering an INVALID token to ensure it throws an IOException.
Test the nextRecord method when encountering COMMENT tokens to ensure it correctly handles and stores comments.

cases.expected: IllegalStateException with message indicating unexpected token type
cases.description: Test the nextRecord method when encountering an unexpected token type to ensure it throws an IllegalStateException.
Test the nextRecord method when the recordList is empty to ensure it returns null.

group: nextRecord - Valid Token Processing with Multiple Tokens

cases.expected: CSVRecord object with multiple populated values
cases.description: Test the nextRecord method with multiple valid tokens to ensure it processes and returns a CSVRecord with all values correctly populated.

cases.expected: CSVRecord object with mixed values and comments
cases.description: Test the nextRecord method when encountering a mix of TOKEN and COMMENT tokens to ensure it correctly handles and stores all values and comments.

cases.expected: CSVRecord object with trailer comment and values
cases.description: Test the nextRecord method when encountering EOF token with ready state and trailing comments to ensure it adds both correctly.

cases.expected: CSVRecord object with last record values for consecutive EORECORD
cases.description: Test the nextRecord method when encountering multiple consecutive EORECORD tokens to ensure it handles them correctly and returns the last record.

group: nextRecord - Handling of Empty CSV Input

cases.description: Test the nextRecord method when the CSV input is empty to ensure it returns null.

cases.expected: IOException with message indicating lexer not initialized
cases.description: Test the nextRecord method when the lexer is not initialized to ensure it throws an IOException.
Test the nextRecord method when the lexer throws an IOException during token retrieval to ensure it propagates the exception.
